description: Add, remove or list your own tools. It changes only your own tool list (your definition and other agents stay as they are) and takes effect from your next turn. Examples: {"op": "ls"}; {"op": "add", "name": "math", "path": "tools/math"}; {"op": "rm", "name": "math"}. path is a tool folder, relative to your workspace or absolute under lib/; replace: true replaces a tool with the same name; envs sets fixed environment values for that tool; env_file names a file of secrets read on every call. op ls: one JSON line. Errors: ArgumentsBad, PathBad, PathMissing, ToolExists, ToolMissing, DaemonMissing (daemon is missing), DaemonFailed (daemon did not reply), InstanceMissing. Details: memory node me/self_tools.

op.description: add = add a tool, rm = remove one, ls = list them

name.description: add, rm: the tool name; the name you will call it by afterwards

path.description: add: the tool folder, relative to the workspace (like tools/math) or an absolute path under lib/

replace.description: add: true replaces a tool you already have with the same name (default false)

envs.description: add, optional: environment values for every call of this tool, like {"AOS_MEMORY": "/data/memory"}; stored as written, not for secrets

env_file.description: add, optional: a file of KEY=VALUE lines read on every call (for secrets); same location rules as path
